turns.content: Let B_n be the additive semigroup generated by A_n={2^n-2^k:0<=k<n}. Choose its smallest generator M=2^(n-1) as a modulus and write the other generators c_k=2^n-2^k.
For each residue r modulo M, let w_r be the least element of B_n in that residue. Explain why the largest gap equals max_r w_r-M.
Show that a least residue representative contains no copy of M and no repeated generator c_k: replacing two equal c_k by c_{k+1} decreases the sum by 2M while preserving its residue.
Relate a no-repeat sum of c_k to a subset of the binary powers 2^k and explain how its residue modulo M determines the subset.
Derive a least representative in each residue class modulo the varying generator c_k rather than modulo M.
Describe the maximizing subset using powers of M instead of powers of two.
Check that the Apéry-set argument both makes this value nonrepresentable and guarantees that every larger integer is representable.
Report the largest positive integer not expressible as a nonempty sum of elements of A_n.
